name: swarm-shared
description: The platform-independent part of the agent swarm (examples/swarm): the session's state machine, its ids and types, the answer checks, the event cursor and the HTTP API as a fetch-style handler over Web APIs. Shared by the swarm on every platform; never published.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
